# _stream fixtures

SYNTHETIC. Hand-built (not captured) from the layout pinned by the live
capture `testdata/fixtures/GenerateFreeFormStreamed/live_2026-10-13_01.json`
and `research/rpc-catalog.md` section 4. Replace with captures as they arrive.

Shape of each stream frame: `["wrb.fr", null, "<inner JSON>"]` (rpc id is null).
Inner payload: `[row, null, markers, followups, isFinal, null, tag]` where
`row = [text, null, [conv, resp, n], null, typeBlock]`, `typeBlock = [rich, null, null,
passages, flag]` (flag 1 answer, 2 thinking), passage = `[x, [.., .., .., .., citedText,
[[[sourceId]]], ..]]`, marker = `[[null, start, end], [passage index, ...]]` (citation N = index+1; live captures 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-20 show an index list, not a range).

| file | covers |
|---|---|
| thinking_then_answer.txt | flag 2 chunks, then cumulative answer, isFinal on last |
| citations_rewrite.txt | `[2][3]` rewritten to `[2-5]`, markers in the old range form `[from, to)` (kept unchanged; see below) |
| citations_rewrite_list.txt | the same rewrite with markers as index lists (`[1]`, `[2]`, then `[1,2,3,4]`) |
| emoji_utf16.txt | astral character, offsets in UTF-16 units; marker in the old range form `[0,1]` |
| emoji_utf16_list.txt | the same with the marker as an index list `[0]` |
| heartbeat.txt | `[]` payload chunks between answers |
| quota_rejection.txt | null payload, google.rpc.Status code 8 with UserDisplayableError |
| truncated.txt | final segment cut mid-JSON |

Regenerated by a throwaway script; the files are the source of truth. The two range-form files predate the live captures, which showed markers are index lists; they are kept as made and pinned by `TestStreamRangeFormSyntheticFixtures`, while the `_list` files carry the behavior tests.
